verdict.rationale: No evidence directly documents retention settings or deletion workflows. The only relevant support is indirect: Unleash can be self-hosted via Docker, which keeps data in the user's own environment, and Edge processes targeting PII locally without sending it to Unleash Cloud or the upstream instance. That is data minimization and data locality, not retention or deletion control. Missing for 10: configurable data retention policies, documented data/user deletion or purge mechanisms, account/data deletion on cloud, independent corroboration.
